positive_snippets: Fabulous hotel, catering superbly in accommodation, dietary needs ( gluten free) and friendliness. Their staff are flexible, helpful and go out of their way to make your stay wonderful. Vijay was OUTSTANDING  in helping my friend sort out her visa issues. Ram brilliant at helping me break a large ruppee note.  I would have no hesitation in recommending this hotel and will definitely stay here again when in Delhi

Excellent Service by Sugar at Pillazo Hotel
I had a wonderful experience at Pillazo Hotel, and a big reason for that was Sugar. He was extremely polite, attentive, and professional throughout my stay. He made sure everything was taken care of promptly and always with a smile. His warm attitude and dedication to excellent service truly made a difference and enhanced our overall experience. Thank you, Sugar, for the outstanding hospitality — you are a real asset to the hotel!
